title: De minimis boundary — exceeded on a single day
description: Holdings cost NZD 49,000 all year until a NZD 3,000 purchase on 2 Feb 2026 pushes the running total to NZD 52,000 for 12 days. Exceeding the threshold on even one day brings the WHOLE portfolio into FIF for the WHOLE year — including the first $50,000. The FDR figure of NZD 2,450.00 is 5% of the full NZD 49,000 opening value, not of the NZD 2,000 excess. IRD USD rate is 1.0 so the FX layer does not obscure the timeline arithmetic.
